title: Tiny, cute compass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#f4c542' stroke='#c89b1e' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='#eaf2f8' stroke='#b8ccd8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <g stroke='#9db3c2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='27' x2='50' y2='33'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='71' x2='50' y2='77'/>
    <line x1='25' y1='52' x2='31' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='69' y1='52' x2='75' y2='52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- needle: north (red) -->
  <polygon points='50,32 56,52 44,52' fill='#e8503a'/>
  <!-- needle: south (blue) -->
  <polygon points='50,72 56,52 44,52' fill='#3b6fd4'/>
  <!-- needle pivot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='4' fill='#f4c542' stroke='#c89b1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- little stars / sparkles for cuteness -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='40' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='64' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- top loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#f4c542' stroke-width='4'/>
</svg>
